description: This Java source file defines the `IPCHelper` class, which provides utility methods to facilitate Inter-Process Communication (IPC) operations such as sending requests, and getting or setting values of various data types (Integer, Long, Double, Boolean, String). The class simplifies common IPC patterns like simple send, get, and set operations with logging and error handling.

classes.name: IPCHelper
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to perform common IPC requests such as sending messages or retrieving and setting data of various types.

methods.name: simpleSend
methods.description: Sends a message with specified server port and message code, with an optional input object; returns true if successful.

methods.name: simpleGetInt
methods.description: Performs an IPC request to retrieve an Integer, with optional input argument.

methods.name: simpleSetInt
methods.description: Sends an Integer value via IPC, optionally retrieves output.

methods.name: simpleGetLong
methods.description: Performs an IPC request to retrieve a Long, with optional input argument.

methods.name: simpleSetLong
methods.description: Sends a Long value via IPC, optionally retrieves output.

methods.name: simpleGetDouble
methods.description: Performs an IPC request to retrieve a Double, with optional input argument.

methods.name: simpleSetDouble
methods.description: Sends a Double value via IPC, optionally retrieves output.

methods.name: simpleGetBoolean
methods.description: Performs an IPC request to retrieve a Boolean, with optional input argument.

methods.name: simpleSetBoolean
methods.description: Sends a Boolean value via IPC, optionally retrieves output.

methods.name: simpleGetString
methods.description: Performs an IPC request to retrieve a String, with optional input argument.

methods.name: simpleSetString
methods.description: Sends a String value via IPC, optionally retrieves output.
